info: A displacement reaction occurs when a more reactive element replaces a less reactive element from its compound. When iron is placed in copper sulfate solution, iron displaces copper and forms iron sulfate while copper is deposited on the iron surface. The reaction is Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu. This happens because iron is more reactive than copper.

questions.questionText: What happens in a displacement reaction?
options: A more reactive element replaces a less reactive element from its compound
One compound breaks into simpler substances
Two compounds combine to form one substance
A substance changes only its physical state

questions.questionText: What happens when an iron nail is placed in copper sulfate solution?
options: Iron displaces copper from copper sulfate
Copper displaces iron from the nail
